items.description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi AI — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. As a Strategic Account Executive at Bloomreach, you will lead new-business sales in multi-stakeholder environments and manage end-to-end, complex deal cycles. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pricing, negotiation, and close—delivering new revenue across the Spanish market. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and key internal teams, as well as external partners, to open, advance, and win strategic opportunities. Your work will be pivotal in driving our growth in the region. Key Responsibilities: Develop and execute a targeted cross-regional sales strategy to penetrate key prospects (C-level), acquire new logos, and drive revenue growth Act as the CEO of your territory by assembling and leading a cross-functional virtual team to execute go-to-market strategies, including entering new markets or developing green markets when required. Hand over the deals to the Account Management to ensure a seamless customer experience Qualify leads early and effectively by identifying pain points and matching personas to Bloomreach’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP). Demonstrate strong proficiency in sales methodologies such as Value-Based Selling, MEDDPICC, or Challenger Sales to navigate complex sales cycles and drive high-value deals. Ensure a robust sales pipeline by maintaining 3x the quarterly target through active prospecting and engaging effectively with C-level clients via various channels, including cold-calls, marketing lead follow-ups, RFPs, professional relationships, local marketing agency contacts, webinars, networking and face-to-face meetings. Collaborate closely with your CEA, channel partner, marketing, enablement, product and customer success teams, to revive old or stalled opportunities, qualify opportunities, and actively mature opportunities consistently Conduct thorough business needs analyses, prepare high-level client briefs, demos, and proposals presenting the unique value proposition of Bloomreach, and explain how it satisfies their needs. Clearly articulate how Bloomreach provides value over competitors and ensures shortlisting for purchasing decisions. Understand the Request for Proposal (RFP) process and influence it early on. Manage the CRM system to ensure accurate reporting and forecasting, maintaining high standards of data hygiene. Multithread to build and maintain solid long-term client relationships with key decision-makers and influencers, offering regular follow-ups and checking in on evolving needs. Provide insights on market trends, competitive landscape, and customer feedback to improve our product and sales effectiveness. Demonstrate initiative in your role to grow the business. Consistently achieve and exceed new business revenue targets. Act as a mentor or "buddy" for other regions, teams and junior team members. Follow instructions of the manager and complete additional duties as needed. What We’re Looking For: 5+ years years of quota-carrying experience (B2B sales) selling software or software-as-a-service (SaaS) Deep knowledge of MarTech technologies, CRM, Marketing Automation, CMS, Search and Merch or data capabilities A proven track record of meeting and exceeding revenue quota in a Sales Manager or equivalent role Well-established presence in the local markets with a relevant network The ability to successfully negotiate and close deals in a highly collaborative team environment Detail oriented, relationship-building skills, and a focus on a high level of customer service, having a passion for building rapport with clients and helping their businesses The ability to adapt to new environments and use your own initiative Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including high-calibre presentation skills Excellent time management skills, positive attitude and a “love of selling” The base salary range for this position is €62,000-€77,500. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. #LI-SF1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Base Salary Range €62.000—€77.500 EUR More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.4/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program -- participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. items.description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: As a founding Strategic Sales Director for Iberia, you will own 8-12 of the largest strategic accounts across Spain and/or Portugal — IBEX35-caliber banking, telco, insurance, utilities, and travel enterprises. You'll run complex, multi-level sales cycles from 6 to 18 months, build both the business case and the technical win alongside your Solutions Consultant, and drive long-term land-and-expand strategy while continuing to bring in new logos. As part of the founding Iberia team, you'll work alongside a 10-person Madrid-based org (SDR, SC, and Customer Success) and help shape the region's go-to-market strategy from the ground up. Responsibilities: Manage a portfolio of 8-12 top strategic accounts in Spain and/or Portugal Generate your own pipeline — Cresta drives strong inbound, but Strategic AEs are expected to self-source roughly 50% of pipeline Orchestrate complex, multi-level sales cycles (6-18 months) across buying committees, procurement, legal, and security Build the business case and the technical win in partnership with your Solutions Consultant and extended team Drive land-and-expand strategy with a long-term vision for each account, while continuing to prioritize new-logo acquisition Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience Qualifications We Value: 8+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, including at least 4 years as a quota-carrying individual contributor selling into large Spanish enterprises (IBEX35 or equivalent: banking, telco, insurance, utilities, travel) Verified track record closing deals of €500K+ ARR / €1M+ TCV, including at least one deal exceeding €1M TCV at an IBEX35-caliber account New-logo hunting as your primary motion — majority of attainment historically from net-new logos rather than installed-base expansion Experience navigating complex 6-18 month cycles, including RFPs, buying committees, and procurement/legal/security review in regulated industries Existing C-level/VP network within Spanish enterprise accounts Nice-to-Have: CX / contact center / conversational AI domain exposure (CCaaS, WEM, analytics, virtual agents) Experience opening a market or territory from zero for a hyper-growth vendor Experience co-selling with SIs and channel partners (e.g. Accenture, Telefónica Tech, Sabio-type ecosystem) Familiarity with Ley SAC and Spanish regulatory drivers in customer service MEDDPICC (or equivalent) formally trained Language & Travel: Native or negotiation-grade Spanish, fluent English; Portuguese is a strong plus Madrid-based, with travel across the Iberian Peninsula expected Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced Compensation at Cresta Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed. OTE Range: TBD (comp benchmarking in progress) + Offers Equity We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

J. Keller & Associates, Inc. is a North American organization providing innovative safety and regulatory compliance guidance and solutions to organizations across the U. S. and Canada. For over 70 years, organizations of all sizes have relied on J. J. Keller to help them create safe work environments for their employees and comply with ever-changing regulations. As we look to expand our service offerings, we are seeking to add an Independent Contractor to our Workplace Safety Consulting practice who has subject matter expertise related to OSHA General Industry . This opportunity is for an Independent Contractor only and does not constitute an employment relationship. Independent Contractors must reside in the U. S. and be legally authorized to perform services within the United States. To be considered as an Independent Contractor, individuals must: Operate as an independent safety consulting business (e.g., sole proprietor, incorporated entity, or equivalent) Provide services to multiple clients and maintain a non-exclusive consulting practice Supply their own tools, methodologies, instructional materials, and business processes necessary to deliver services Be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business-related expenses Provide their own computer, equipment, and tools necessary to perform services Maintain appropriate professional liability coverage, as required under the contractual agreement Travel requirements vary based on client engagements, audit needs, and training delivery, and are defined by project or statement of work. Types of Services Requested Provides expert advice, safety consulting and educational services to J. J. Keller clients on construction safety and health matters through onsite engagements, off-site locations, and/or internet-based delivery methods in accordance with defined project scope. Designs, develops, documents, and maintains training curriculum and instructional materials for general and client-specific applications. Conducts safety audits, inspections, and risk assessments, based on applicable regulatory standards and client requirements related to excavation, fall protection, scaffolding, trenching, heavy equipment, electrical safety, and roadway work zones. Monitors relevant regulatory and compliance applicable to the scope of service and incorporate changes into deliverables and training content as appropriate. Communicates regulatory updates, recommendations, and findings to designated client contacts through reports, briefings, or presentations. Provides advisory support to interpret regulatory requirements and practical application, without assuming responsibility for client compliance enforcement or ongoing operational oversight. Qualifications Experience: Extensive experience in construction safety and health, with a strong focus on OSHA General Industry. Demonstrated expertise providing safety consulting, regulatory advisory, auditing, and training services to commercial or industrial clients. Other Skills/Qualifications : Strong understanding of federal, state, and local safety regulations. Proven history of providing independent safety consulting services within consulting and/or complex corporate environments. Proficiency using business productivity tools (MS Office suite) necessary to deliver reports, presentations, and training materials. Excellent communication skills – verbal, written and presentation Demonstrated ability to work effectively with client representatives at all levels. Maintains a high level of regulatory expertise. Strong working knowledge of sales, marketing, and finance concepts related to operating an independent consulting practice. Ability to legally operate a motor vehicle to perform required services. Physical Requirements Work is performed primarily in a standard office environment. Work involves operation of personal computer equipment for extended periods of time. Frequent travel to offsite offices, customer sites and/or industry and training events is required. Travel Requirements: 80% We Protect People & The Businesses They Run™ J. J. Keller History: November 1, 2023, marked 70 years of business for J. J. Keller & Associates, Inc. Click HERE to take a tour through three generations of this family-owned business – from our founding as a one-man consulting firm through decades of delivering on our purpose of protecting people and the businesses they run. items.summary: BriefCC. Talent is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join the accounting team of a growing company in the luxury technology and home automation industry.
items.description: Brief CC.Talent is looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable Specialist to join the accounting team of a growing company in the luxury technology and home automation industry. The ideal candidate will have strong Accounts Receivable experience, advanced QuickBooks Online skills, excellent attention to detail, and a proactive approach to improving financial processes and workflows. About the Client Our client is a premier luxury technology integration company specializing in residential audio/video, lighting control, motorized window treatments, networking, and home automation solutions. They serve discerning clients who expect high-quality experiences, innovative technology, and exceptional service. The company has a strong focus on continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and operational excellence, encouraging team members to identify better ways of working and contribute to the overall growth of the business. Responsibilities Accounts Receivable Generate and distribute client invoices accurately and on schedule. Monitor outstanding accounts and proactively manage collections. Follow up professionally and consistently on overdue invoices. Maintain accurate client account records and payment histories. Process and correctly apply client payments. Reconcile accounts receivable balances and investigate discrepancies. Assist with month-end financial closing and reporting activities. Process Improvement & Technology Utilize QuickBooks Online effectively for daily accounting activities. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and visibility within accounting processes. Recommend and support automation, workflow improvements, and system enhancements. Investigate recurring issues and identify root causes. Help implement long-term solutions rather than temporary fixes. Support the adoption of new accounting technologies and best practices. Communication & Collaboration Work closely with internal teams to ensure billing accuracy. Communicate professionally with clients regarding invoices, payment schedules, and account balances. Escalate collection concerns and payment risks when necessary. Support accounting projects and other departmental initiatives as assigned. Requirements 3+ years of experience in Accounts Receivable, Accounting Administration, or a related role. Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks Online is required. Strong understanding of Accounts Receivable processes and collections. Experience with invoicing, payment processing, reconciliations, and collections. Strong Microsoft Excel and data management skills. Comfortable working with cloud-based business systems and learning new technologies. Experience with D-Tools Cloud and Microsoft 365 is preferred. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to investigate discrepancies and identify root causes. Strong attention to detail and accuracy when handling financial information. Excellent organizational and communication skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams. A proactive mindset with an interest in process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. Highlights Accounts Receivable Specialist Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing product company building scalable EdTech products for a global audience. As our business and product portfolio continue to grow, we are strengthening our Talent Acquisition team and looking for a Senior Recruiter to own complex, business-critical hiring across the company. This is a full-cycle role with a strong focus on direct search, hiring manager partnership, and measurable outcomes. You will lead 4-6 roles at a time - including Senior, Lead, and Head-level positions - and help us build the systems that make every next hire more focused, predictable, and effective. What You’ll Do Own 4-6 vacancies end to end, with a focus on senior, leadership, and business-critical roles. Partner with hiring managers from the kick-off stage: clarify the business need, shape a realistic candidate profile, define the scorecard, and align on the hiring process. Build a sourcing strategy for each role, including talent-market mapping, donor-company research, Boolean and X-ray search, LinkedIn sourcing, and personalized outreach sequences. Proactively engage passive candidates instead of relying mainly on inbound applications. Conduct structured interviews, assess candidates against agreed criteria, and provide clear, evidence-based recommendations. Prepare and calibrate hiring managers and interviewers to ensure consistent, high-quality assessment across all stages. Own the recruitment funnel and use data to identify bottlenecks, improve stage conversions, and keep stakeholders aligned on progress and risks. Manage the offer process and candidate communication through to the person’s first working day. Bring market intelligence to the business: talent availability, compensation expectations, competitor insights, and realistic hiring timelines. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of experience in full-cycle recruitment, including at least 4 years in a product IT company. Experience hiring for Growth Marketing, Product, Analytics, or Engineering roles. Experience in B2C subscription products, mobile apps, EdTech, or another high-growth digital environment. A proven track record of closing Senior, Lead, or Head-level roles, with the ability to explain your approach, funnel metrics, timelines, and results. Strong hands-on sourcing expertise and confidence working with passive talent across multiple channels. Experience partnering with hiring managers, challenging unclear or unrealistic requirements, and translating business needs into an actionable search strategy. A structured, data-informed approach to recruitment: you understand funnel metrics, conversion rates, and how to use them to improve outcomes. Experience with competency-based assessment, scorecards, and structured interviews. Strong ownership and communication skills, with the ability to manage several priorities and keep stakeholders aligned. Practical use of AI tools in day-to-day recruiting - for research, sourcing, communication, analysis, or workflow automation. Fluency in Ukrainian with English at B2 level or above. Why You’ll Love Working With Us High-impact hiring: You’ll own roles that directly affect product delivery, team capability, and business growth. Room to shape the function: Our Talent Acquisition system is evolving, and you’ll have a real voice in how we build processes, tools, and standards. Direct partnership: You’ll work closely with hiring managers and business leaders, with clear access to decision-makers. AI-enabled workflow: We provide access to AI subscriptions and modern recruiting tools to automate routine work and focus on higher-value decisions. Health support: We offer medical expense compensation. Work-life balance: You’ll have flexible paid time off, including 21 days of annual leave plus 10 bank holidays. Collaborative culture: You’ll work with curious, driven people who value ownership, clarity, and evidence-based decisions. Hiring Process Introductory call with the Head of People - 30 minutes. Functional interview - 60 minutes. Live recruitment case - 60 minutes, with no take-home assignment. Final meeting - 30 minutes. If you enjoy solving complex hiring challenges, working closely with the business, and building systems rather than simply following them, we’d love to hear from you. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: ABOUT YLABSYLabs is a leading global design and research organization designing technologies that amplify youth power, agency, and opportunity.
items.description: ABOUT YLABS YLabs is a leading global design and research organization designing technologies that amplify youth power, agency, and opportunity. Founded in 2014 at the Harvard Innovation Lab, YLabs partners with young people to co-create inclusive digital products and services that improve their lives. Our design process opens spaces where young people’s ideas can become a reality – where they are the architects of the solutions to their most pressing challenges. YLabs multidisciplinary team delivers youth-driven innovation and impact at scale. Our team combines expertise in youth-driven design with adolescent health, climate, livelihoods, digital product design, behavioral science, and epidemiology. Based in Rwanda and the USA, we’ve worked in 18 countries to date on projects spanning three focus areas: optimum health and wellness, improved economic opportunity, and increased climate resilience. Find out more about our projects here: JOB SUMMARY We are seeking a Costing and Evaluation Specialist to support our Climate-SRHR project by leading development of a climate-SRHR cost model for Ethiopia. This position is ideal for someone with strong skills in health program costing, economic evaluation, and health benefit estimation who is looking for flexible, project-based work. Over the course of approximately 55 working days, the Costing and Evaluation Specialist will play a key role in developing a methodologically rigorous cost model structure that is transparent in its assumptions, defensible to donor and government audiences, and replicable as a global public good. In this position, you will work with internal climate change and SRHR technical experts at YLabs , as well as an Ethiopia-based in-country specialist, to provide additional technical input and guidance to ensure the model outputs are relevant, accurate, and meaningful. JOB TYPE This is an independent contractor (Consultancy) position. The position is fully remote. LOCATION This is a fully remote role open to candidates globally. Strong familiarity with Ethiopia’s health system and/or prior experience working with Ethiopian health data is strongly preferred. ABOUT YLABS’ COMPENSATION YLabs adheres to Project Fair’s principles and standards to establish equity in pay with the overriding principle of “equal pay for work of equal value” outlined in the Sustainable Development Goals. All salary ranges are based on level within the organization and are competitive to regional and national salary benchmarks, based on the respective office location. PAY RATE The estimated contract length is 55 days. Compensation is benchmarked to the candidate's region. Indicative ranges: • US: $59–$87.50 USD per hour • Rwanda: $24–$38.50 USD per hour • Other regions: Determined based on local market rates and shared early in the hiring process. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We need someone who is equally comfortable writing C and JavaScript. The Bare team builds and maintains the runtime itself along with a growing ecosystem of native modules (bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto, and many more). You would be writing native addons that bridge platform APIs into JavaScript, debugging across multiple operating systems, and helping keep the runtime small and correct. This is a hands-on systems role. You will work independently, own modules end to end, and ship code that runs on phones, laptops, servers, and constrained devices. Native module development Design, implement, and ship bare-* native modules (e.g., bare-bluetooth, bare-tcp, bare-fs, bare-crypto) end to end, including code, and tests Write C native addons that bridge platform APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem, crypto) into JavaScript Maintain and extend existing native modules based on product team requests and the bare-node compatibility list Cross-platform builds and CI Set up and maintain cross-platform builds for macOS, Linux, Android (NDK), and iOS (Xcode) Own cross-compilation toolchain configuration for each target platform Maintain CI pipelines that build and test native modules across all supported platforms Investigate and fix platform-specific build failures and toolchain issues Bare Runtime contributions Contribute to the Bare runtime core (module system, native addon system, light-weight threads) Help reduce the bare-node missing API surface Participate in evaluating and integrating alternative JS engines eg libjerry Debugging and quality Debug native addon issues across multiple OS and device targets, including mobile Write and maintain tests for all modules Collaboration and communication Respond to Bare team inquiries from internal teams and the public. Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions in writing . Participate in a weekly status call. Participate in Bare workshops and contribute to onboarding materials. Coordinate with product teams (Keet, WDK/Wallet). Requirements Strong C programming skills, including experience writing and debugging native code across platforms. Advanced JavaScript skills with a solid understanding of internals and the module ecosystem. Experience building native addons for or similar runtimes (N-API, node-gyp, or equivalent). Familiarity with libuv or other asynchronous I/O frameworks. Comfortable working across macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS build toolchains. Experience with cross-compilation and platform-specific system APIs (Bluetooth, networking, filesystem). Ability to read and navigate large C and C++ codebases. Self-directed work style with strong written communication skills. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada - Remote Description de l'entreprise Workleap est une entreprise tech basée à Montréal avec comme mission de rendre le travail plus simple. Depuis 2006, on bâtit des produits innovants qui aident les équipes RH et TI à relever leurs plus grands défis. Workleap offre deux lignes de produits distinctes : La plateforme Workleap , une solution RH propulsée par l’IA qui élève la performance des équipes et stimule l’engagement des employés. ShareGate , le leader incontesté en migration et gouvernance Microsoft 365, reconnu par les professionnels TI du monde entier pour sa grande simplicité. Aujourd’hui, c’est plus de 20 000 entreprises partout dans le monde qui comptent sur les produits Workleap pour croître, évoluer et opérer. On est des bâtisseurs dans l’âme et ce qui nous passionne est clair : créer les produits les plus simples qui amènent de la valeur exceptionnelle à nos clients, un point c’est tout. Description du poste Concrètement à quoi va ressembler ton poste ? En tant que Senior Designer de Produit sur ShareGate Migrate , tu travailleras au sein d’un trio produit étroitement collaboratif (PM, Tech Lead, Designer) pour façonner l’expérience d’un produit utilisé dans des projets à fort impact et à forte sensibilité opérationnelle. Tu concevras des solutions qui aident les administrateurs TI à naviguer dans des scénarios de migration complexes avec clarté et confiance. Ton travail couvre à la fois la stratégie et l’exécution : définition des problématiques, conception des parcours et des interactions, affinage des détails d’interface, et itérations rapides basées sur les apprentissages. Tu exploreras de manière réfléchie comment l’ IA peut enrichir l’expérience, que ce soit pour simplifier la planification, faire émerger des insights pertinents ou guider les équipes dans leurs décisions techniques. C’est une occasion de travailler sur des enjeux concrets ayant un impact réel sur l’évolution des environnements numériques des organisations. Tu t’épanouiras dans ce rôle si tu aimes la complexité, collabores naturellement avec les ingénieurs et les PM, et accordes une grande importance à la création d’expériences utilisateur fiables, réfléchies et capables de passer à l’échelle. Responsabilités : Piloter le design de bout en bout au sein de ton équipe produit, de la définition des problèmes jusqu’au raffinement des interactions finales ; Transformer des parcours ambigus ou techniques en expériences intuitives et utiles pour des professionnels TI ; Concevoir des parcours, interfaces et interactions qui simplifient les scénarios de migration Microsoft 365 et cloud ; Collaborer étroitement avec les PM, les ingénieurs et les experts métier pour clarifier le périmètre et aligner la stratégie ; Prototyper, tester et itérer rapidement afin de valider les hypothèses et renforcer les solutions ; Utiliser les données, les retours clients et les insights produit pour guider les décisions et améliorer les résultats ; Explorer des opportunités liées à l’IA pour rendre les flux de migration et de gouvernance plus efficaces, prédictifs et fiables ; Contribuer à l’amélioration des pratiques design à l’aide de nouveaux outils, d’innovations et de nouvelles méthodologies ; Participer à l’évolution du design system et veiller à la cohérence de l’expérience à travers ShareGate. Une semaine typique? Tu évolueras naturellement entre exploration stratégique, design concret et collaboration étroite. Concrètement, tu pourras : Contribuer à la direction produit lors des activités de planification et de découverte en trio ; Traduire les besoins clients et les opportunités business en parcours clairs, wireframes et prototypes ; Travailler avec l’ingénierie pour affiner le périmètre, comprendre les contraintes et maintenir un haut niveau de qualité design tout au long du développement ; Présenter des travaux en cours aux équipes et aux parties prenantes lors de critiques ou de revues asynchrones ; Analyser les données de migration, les tendances de support et les comportements utilisateurs pour éclairer les décisions ; Raffiner les détails d’interaction et assurer des hand-offs clairs et cohérents ; Documenter les décisions et communiquer efficacement le raisonnement derrière les choix effectués ; Utiliser des outils d’IA pour mieux comprendre nos utilisateurs et augmenter ton efficacité ; Prototyper régulièrement avec des outils de prototypage assistés par l’IA pour communiquer, tester et valider les solutions. Tu bénéficieras d’autonomie, de responsabilité, et d’une équipe qui valorise l’exécution réfléchie et l’apprentissage continu. Qui est l’équipe que tu vas rejoindre ? Tu rejoindras une équipe multidisciplinaire où les designers sont impliqués tôt, influencent la direction produit et collaborent étroitement avec l’ingénierie et la gestion de produit. Le design chez Workleap est collaboratif, riche en feedback, et engagé à constamment élever le niveau, autant dans les processus que dans la qualité du craft. Quels sont les prochains défis qui attendent ton équipe ? ShareGate évolue rapidement, et les défis design à venir demandent à la fois créativité et rigueur. Tu contribueras notamment à : Des scénarios de migration à l’échelle entreprise, où la clarté, la prévisibilité et l’efficacité sont essentielles ; La modernisation des expériences clés de ShareGate Migrate et de l’écosystème plus large ; L’évolution d’un design system en croissance, soutenant de nouveaux patterns, l’accessibilité et la cohérence multi-produits ; Des expériences de planification et de guidance AI-native pour aider les équipes TI à anticiper les risques et prendre des décisions éclairées. C’est un rôle où tu peux influencer non seulement le fonctionnement du produit aujourd’hui, mais aussi son évolution sur les prochaines années. Qualifications 6+ ans d’expérience en design de produits B2B SaaS au sein d’équipes multidisciplinaires ; Fort sens de l’utilisateur et aisance dans des environnements ambigus et techniquement complexes ; Maîtrise de la stratégie, des parcours UX, du design UI et des détails d’interaction soignés ; Capacité à trouver l’équilibre entre rapidité d’exécution et haute qualité ; Expérience auprès d’audiences techniques (TI, outils d’administration, plateformes) — un atout ; Expérience en conception ou collaboration sur des fonctionnalités propulsées par l’IA ; Excellentes compétences en communication et en storytelling ; Grand souci du détail et engagement fort envers la qualité du design. Fourchette salariale : 120–145 k $ CAD. La fourchette salariale affichée reflète notre échelle de rémunération au Canada. Au moment de formuler une offre, selon la région où le candidat est basé, certains ajustements peuvent s’appliquer afin de refléter les conditions du marché local. Qui nous sommes On est une équipe de curieux et de créateurs passionnés, rassemblés par le même objectif : rendre le travail plus simple - et meilleur - pour tout le monde. Les défis stimulent notre créativité, on carbure à l'intensité, et repousser les limites fait partie de notre ADN. On pense que les meilleures idées naissent de l’expérimentation, de l’apprentissage continu, et parfois même de l’inconfort—c’est comme ça qu’on évolue. Depuis 2006, on réinvente la façon dont les équipes travaillent, en alliant créativité et technologie pour résoudre de vrais problèmes en TI et en RH. On avance vite, on apprend constamment, et on garde toujours nos clients au coeur de nos décisions. Si tu es une personne proactive, qui prend les choses en main, adore collaborer et n’a pas peur de plonger dans l’inconnu - tu trouveras parfaitement ta place parmi nous. Informations supplémentaires Chez Workleap, on bâtit ensemble, on se fait confiance et on se soutient, dans la réussite ou dans l'échec. Tu pourras t'exprimer, évoluer et développer ta créativité dans un environnement qui s'adaptera à ton quotidien et à tes besoins. Nos aspirations sont de bâtir un environnement de travail sain et inclusif. Il s’agit là de l’affaire de tous et de toutes. Notre processus Expérience Candidat chez Workleap : Entrevue téléphonique - Entrevue virtuelle par Teams - Mise en situation - Offre d'emploi En tant qu’entreprise technologique, nous utilisons l’IA pour optimiser le recrutement, tout en veillant à ce que toutes les décisions d’évaluation restent humaines. On a hâte d'apprendre à te connaître ! En postulant à ce poste, tu confirmes avoir lu et être en accord avec notre politique de confidentialité . #LI-Remote To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/sharegate-migrate-chezworkleap-senior-product-designer-sharegate-migrate

items.description: Design Headquarters: Egypt iSchool is an innovative and rapidly growing e-learning company that provides online coding and artificial intelligence education to students aged 6 to 18 years old. As a leading platform in the industry, we are committed to equipping the next generation with the skills they need to thrive in the digital era. We are currently seeking a dynamic and passionate individual to join our team as a Coding Instructor for a project-based position lasting 3 months. Overview We are seeking a Digital Arts Track Instructor responsible for delivering engaging, hands-on sessions that introduce students to the fundamentals of digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D content creation. The instructor will guide students through practical creative workflows using industry-relevant tools such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. The role focuses on helping students understand core visual design principles, animation fundamentals, and digital media production while encouraging creativity, problem-solving, and project-based learning. Key Responsibilities Deliver structured sessions covering digital design, animation, video editing, and 3D modeling fundamentals. Teach students how to use digital creative tools including Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity. Guide students through hands-on projects such as designing logos, creating vector illustrations, producing short videos, and building simple 3D models. Introduce design principles including shape composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Teach students how to break complex drawings into simple geometric shapes and design creative visual assets. Explain core 2D animation concepts including animation basics, character joints, and shape-based animation techniques. Demonstrate how animation is used in games, cartoons, and digital media. Teach the fundamentals of video editing including trimming clips, arranging timelines, adding text overlays, and adjusting basic audio. Introduce students to 3D modeling concepts using Blender, including navigating the interface and creating simple low‑poly models. Explain the differences between Eevee and Cycles render engines and guide students in exporting visual outputs. Guide students in importing assets into Unity and organizing them for basic game development workflows. Mentor students during exercises and projects while encouraging creativity and experimentation. Strong understanding of digital design fundamentals , including composition, layout, and visual storytelling. Practical experience with digital creative tools , such as Photopea, Figma, Canva, Inkscape, CapCut, Blender, and Unity . Knowledge of vector illustration and digital design workflows . Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals , including shape-based animation and character joints. Basic knowledge of video editing , including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments. Familiarity with 3D modeling concepts in Blender , including creating simple low-poly models. Basic understanding of render engines (Eevee and Cycles) and exporting visual outputs. Basic knowledge of game development workflows , including importing and organizing assets in Unity. Ability to explain complex creative concepts in a simple and engaging way . Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities . Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills . Compatible Salary. Flexible Hours. Certificate of Experience Team Collaboration & Mentorship To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ischool-graphic-design-instructor-project-based

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Canada Rockstar is recruiting for a digital product studio that specializes in turning ideas into extraordinary digital experiences. This client is a dynamic, remote-first team of savvy professionals known for pushing creative boundaries and delivering high-quality, user-centered products through a collaborative and lean approach. This client is building a bench of talented product designers for upcoming client work. They are looking for mid-to-senior-level freelance designers who can bring strong UX thinking, sharp visual design skills, and a collaborative spirit to the team. What they're looking for If you're a seasoned product designer with a passion for digital excellence, this opportunity is for you. You’ve honed your craft over the years, with a deep understanding of UX design, visual storytelling, and collaborative product development. You’re equally comfortable working independently and alongside a cross-functional team. You manage your time well, take ownership of your work, and make confident decisions with minimal oversight. You’re fluent in tools like Figma and Adobe Suite, and you bring a user-first mindset to everything you do — whether designing mobile apps or contributing to product strategy. If you're the type of designer who pushes creative boundaries, communicates clearly, and still knows how to have a little fun in the process — they’d love to hear from you. The Details As a Product Design Contractor, you’ll contribute to a range of client-facing projects, collaborating with the Chief Creative Officer and team across the following areas: - Digital Product Design (Web & App): Shape intuitive experiences by applying research, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that elevate functionality and user engagement. - User Research & Discovery: Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to inform feature planning and prioritization. Help build products grounded in real user needs and business goals. - User Experience (UX): Apply UX methodologies like journey mapping, user flows, and usability testing to define products beyond UI — ensuring seamless and strategic user experiences. - Visual Design: Lead visual direction on select projects, producing compelling layouts and assets that translate beautifully across platforms — from product to marketing. - Presentation Collateral: Design high-impact presentation decks and visuals that bring ideas to life for clients and stakeholders. - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering and product teams by providing annotated designs, QA support, and input during handoff and development. - Additional Design Support: Contribute to project-related needs like case studies, marketing assets, and content design for social media or internal documentation. Qualifications - 4–6 years of experience in product and visual design, with a strong focus on digital experiences across web and/or mobile - Solid understanding of UX principles, including user research, usability testing, and translating insights into design decisions - Demonstrated ability to own features or tracks of work with minimal oversight — from wireframes to high-fidelity execution - Comfortable leading or contributing to discovery phases and helping define product direction in collaboration with strategy and engineering - Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with experience working in a Mac environment - Familiarity with remote collaboration tools such as Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Jira, and Harvest - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a team-first mindset and the ability to clearly articulate design rationale - Organized, proactive, and able to manage your own time in a fast-paced, remote work environment - Bonus: experience working in client-facing or agency settings where flexibility, autonomy, and cross-functional teamwork are key What to Expect from the Process This is a contract-based role and part of an ongoing effort to build relationships with experienced designers for future client projects. Interviews are being conducted on a rolling basis, and while there may not be immediate openings, strong candidates will be added to the contractor roster and considered as new work becomes available. Hiring timelines are directly tied to the sales pipeline, so project start dates vary. The team is committed to matching the right designer to the right project — and they will reach out when there’s a fit. About the Client This client is a digital product studio that brings together design, technology, and creativity to build meaningful experiences. They believe in pushing boundaries, working collaboratively, and delivering high-quality products that they are proud of. The remote-first culture values autonomy, trust, and open communication. The team is always exploring new ideas, evolving their process, and building products that move the needle for their clients. This position is remote and open to all candidates, but applicants based in New York City are prioritized for potential in-person collaboration. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/rockstar-product-designer

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Company Overview Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them. The Role You will serve as the strategic bridge between Finance and our core growth engines, translating complex data into actionable roadmaps for our Marketing and Product leaders. Your mission is to move beyond the numbers, driving operational excellence and ensuring every Euro spent accelerates our global scaling efforts. Key Responsibilities Drive Strategic Alignment: Partner with Marketing and Product leads to co-create annual budgets and rolling forecasts that reflect ambitious growth targets. Maximise Returns: Assist with the delivery and analysis of Customer and Product ROI to ensure marketing spend and feature developments drive high value. Guide Product Innovation: Build robust financial models to evaluate the viability and potential impact of new features and market expansions. Translate Data to Insight: Convert monthly financial results into strategic narratives that help department heads pivot quickly and effectively. Mitigate Risk: Identify operational bottlenecks and financial risks early, providing proactive solutions to keep projects on track. Champion Scalability: Streamline reporting processes to ensure financial transparency as we continue to scale globally. Qualifications Proven Experience: Background in Finance Business Partnering, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or Digital environment. Analytical Rigour: Advanced proficiency in financial modelling and data visualisation tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or SQL). Strategic Mindset: Ability to see the "big picture" and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven storytelling . Adaptability: Experience navigating the fast-paced, evolving landscape of a global scale-up. Commercial Acumen: A deep understanding of digital marketing metrics and product development life-cycle. Good to have Experience in the travel-tech or telecommunications industry. Professional certification (CIMA, ACCA, or MBA). Benefits & Perks Remote Working: Our remote setup is flexible to support work-life balance , allowing you to integrate your professional and personal life seamlessly. Growth Environment: Opportunities to lead high-impact projects in a truly global team focused on psychological safety and autonomy. Self development budget of € 500 . Discounts on e-sim for self, family/friends Apply today and help us transform connectivity for the future of corporate travel and enterprise mobility. Visit us at Holafly.com to explore open positions and learn more about our mission! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/holafly-finance-business-partner-marketing-product

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote URL: http://gowalter.co Description About Simetrik Created in 2019, Simetrik is a robust B2B platform powered by no code and generative AI. It empowers financial and operational teams by allowing them to automate all reconciliations from start to finish, and anticipate and manage risks all on a single, intuitive, and robust interface inspired by spreadsheets. Simetrik was recognized by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in the Americas for 2025, for the second year in a row. Through continuous innovation, we’re dedicated to staying at the forefront of automation with agentic, scalable solutions targeting the biggest challenges in global financial operations. The company's global footprint spans over 35 countries, monitoring over 200 million records daily. About the role As BDR, you will be responsible to make the first contact of prospects via outbound and inbound and generate quality opportunities for the sales force. You will have the chance to focus your attention and efforts on customer acquisition, lead generation, and prospect management, as this role will gather and meet with potential clients. The business development representative will also be responsible to research client business referrals, network, and web leads; provide prospective customers/clients with all services offered and additional presentations as needed, and work with clients to create solutions for their needs and consult throughout the sales process. What you’ll achieve: ● Generate pipeline for enterprise account executives through persistent, high-volume outreach and create customized messaging to drive qualified opportunities and account expansion. ● Leverage a multi-channel outbound prospecting approach (outbound calling, email, LinkedIn Outreach etc.), developing and refining team sequences, templates, and messaging to build a repeatable, scalable process. ● Cultivate value-driven conversations with Director and VP-level personas across complex cross-functional teams and consistently create compelling messaging and events to achieve meeting goals. ● Develop a territory plan with AE and CSM based on account tier scoring to drive the highest ARR. ● Proactively update activity metrics, meetings, SQO, and pipeline on a weekly basis. Identify gaps between prospecting inputs and outputs. ● Effectively execute high-impact trials, meet SLA requirements, and leverage territory heat maps and buyer’s journey to triage target accounts with ABM strategy. ● Understand Simetrik use-cases, relevant workflows/processes, and ways that Simetrik can deliver value. Requirements About you: ● At least 3-4 years of Sales or Sales Development experience. ● Familiarity with sales tools such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Navigator to network with potential customers and manage your book of business. ● Demonstrated success in driving outbound prospecting strategy and process to high-level personas and decision-makers to achieve pipeline goals. ● Passion for a career in technology and an ability to speak knowledgeably about the industry. ● Excellent writing and verbal communication skills, with a focus on persuasive messaging and the ability to tailor your communication style to different audiences. ● Strong collaboration skills, particularly in working with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to drive business outcomes. ● Clear communication, a deep sense of empathy, and a commitment to integrity. ● Demonstrated curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making Benefits Benefits ● Competitive compensation packages ● Ample career growth opportunities as we continue rapidly grow ● Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits, creating and collaborating is everyday business. ● Open communication with management and company leadership. ● Small, dynamic teams = massive impact. ● $500 a year for you to invest in learning. ● Unlimited PTO ● 12 holidays Simetrik considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor. Everyone is welcome! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/walter-business-development-representative

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote (Within 3 hours of EST timezone preferred) What excites you You want to be early. You like being close to the product, the customer, and the messiness of figuring things out. You enjoy turning sharp customer insight into positioning that actually changes behavior. You care about story-telling. You want to build narratives from launches and words to be thoughtful and useful, not generic or AI slop. You’re energized by hospitality. Hotels are complex, human, and operationally intense. That makes the work interesting, particularly in an age of AI. You want real ownership. If something ships poorly, you fix it. If something lands well, you know exactly why. What excites us You’ve spent 5–7 years in product marketing at a high-growth company, ideally B2B SaaS or complex marketplaces. You can explain technical or operational products in a way that feels simple and grounded. You’ve owned messaging and positioning end to end in close partnership with product, sales, and leadership. You’ve rewritten it when it didn’t work. You’ve led go-to-market for real products, not just features. You know how to scope a launch, make tradeoffs, and ship. You care to measure impact post-launch. You’re not precious about what “typical” PMMs look like. You like wearing different hats and can go beyond product marketing to engage contractors for events planning, or work with an agency to test some ads, when needed. You’re comfortable going deep. Customer calls, sales calls, demos, win-loss. You look for signal, not anecdotes. You’re hands-on. You write the first draft. You build the deck. You partner with design, but you don’t wait on them. Bonus if you’ve worked in hospitality, travel, fintech, or vertical SaaS. Bigger bonus if you genuinely like hotels. Working at Folio We're a remote-first company. Three times a year, we travel to work together in-person and stay with one of our hotel partners. We love experimenting with new tools. For the most part, we rely on Google Meet, Linear, Notion, and Slack to make decisions and get things done day-to-day. You will have the opportunity to travel frequently and meet our customers in person at conferences and events, which you will be helping plan for. We're a small team who work collaboratively and meet daily for stand up What we value Craft . We take pride in our work, find joy in execution, and believe that the best companies are built at a steady yet resilient pace. Optimism . We believe in ourselves and each other and know anything is possible with the right amount of hustle and grit. Ownership . We love making things better and have a strong sense of shared responsibility over everything we create together. Hospitality. The industry we’re building for has a culture of service to others, and we bring that energy to how we work together each day. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/folio-product-marketing-manager

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Syracuse, NY, USA URL: http://freseniusmedicalcare.com ADDENDUM: Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions In addition to the responsibilities outlined in the core job description, the Sales Consultant, Hospital Solutions will: Manage all new and existing accounts, identifies and closes new business opportunities, and delivers comprehensive solutions across the full product portfolio for both In Center and Hospital. PURPOSE AND SCOPE: This role is responsible for supporting sales growth and customer engagement driving sales performance, clinical support, and overall customer service within an assigned sales territory. The position manages new and existing accounts, provides product and clinical support, and identifies opportunities to expand utilization across the portfolio. The role builds and maintains strong customer relationships, leads territory-level collaboration with internal partners, and ensures accurate use of sales tools, forecasting, and contract management. Thousands of designers use DesignFiles to manage projects, collaborate with clients, create presentations, source products, and run more profitable businesses. items.description: Design Headquarters: worldwide URL: http://www.brfood.us Senior Remote Team Leader — Accounting, Data & Operations Food Services Inc. — Wholesale meat and restaurant supply distributor based in Los Angeles, California Remote Contractor Position Compensation Starting base compensation: $2,500 USD per month This position includes opportunities for: * Performance bonuses * Responsibility-based increases * Leadership increases * Additional compensation for taking ownership of major business functions A strong performer can grow the base compensation to approximately $3,000 per month within the first year, in addition to applicable performance bonuses. Compensation growth will be based on measurable responsibility, performance, accuracy, leadership, and the ability to independently manage important areas of the business. About the Role: We are looking for a senior-level Accounting & Operations Team Leader who can take ownership of daily workflows, work independently, review the work of others, and turn business data into clear actions and decisions. This is not a basic data-entry position. We are looking for someone who can operate at a top 10% performance level — someone who can analyze, review, identify problems, follow up, and help improve the way the team works. The right person should be comfortable managing both people and data in a fast-moving business environment. Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for helping lead and review daily accounting and operational workflows, including: * Reviewing and analyzing large amounts of business and financial data * Identifying errors, discrepancies, trends, and opportunities * Reviewing team members’ work for accuracy and completion * Purchase Order vs. Vendor Bill analysis * Vendor pricing and quantity discrepancy review * Accounts receivable and customer aging * Vendor aging and accounts payable * Inventory analysis and reconciliation * Price updates and vendor price-list comparisons * Creating and improving Excel reports and tracking systems * Following up on unresolved issues until they are completed * Helping organize team priorities and daily workflow * Communicating clearly with management and team members * Using AI and automation to reduce repetitive work and improve accuracy * Developing better processes, controls, and reporting systems We want someone who does more than complete a task. We expect you to understand the task, review the results, identify what is wrong, and recommend the next action. Required Experience Strong candidates should have professional experience with: * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel — advanced level * Financial data reconciliation * Data analysis and reporting * Purchase orders and vendor bills * Accounts payable and/or accounts receivable * Reviewing and auditing work for accuracy * Managing multiple priorities * Team leadership or senior-level responsibility * Strong written and spoken English You must also be comfortable working daily with: * Zoom * ClickUp * QuickBooks * Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets * Remote desktop and cloud-based systems AI & Automation Experience We are especially interested in candidates who already understand how to use modern technology to improve their work. Experience with any of the following is highly valued: * ChatGPT or other AI tools * AI-assisted data analysis * Workflow automation * Excel automation * Macros * Automated reporting * Process improvement * Building repeatable systems and procedures You do not need to be a programmer, but you should understand how AI and automation can help a business work faster, more accurately, and with fewer manual steps. Leadership Expectations This is a Team Leader role. You should be able to: * Take ownership without waiting for constant instructions * Review other team members’ work * Identify mistakes before they become larger problems * Prioritize tasks based on business importance * Communicate problems clearly * Follow up until issues are resolved * Train and guide junior team members * Keep management updated with meaningful information * Separate urgent issues from routine tasks * Look for opportunities to improve existing processes We are looking for someone who asks: “What does this data tell us, what is the problem, and what action should we take?” —not simply: “What task should I do next?” Work Schedule Monday through Saturday 8-hour shift per day The position operates according to Pacific Time (Los Angeles), and candidates must be able to work consistently within the assigned schedule. Because this is a remote leadership position, reliability, attendance, responsiveness, and availability during working hours are extremely important. Equipment Requirements You must have a professional remote-work setup capable of supporting all-day Zoom, QuickBooks, remote-hosted environments, Excel, ClickUp, and other business applications simultaneously. Required: * Business-class laptop or desktop * Intel Core i7 / AMD Ryzen 7 or equivalent * 32GB RAM minimum * 1TB NVMe SSD preferred * Dual monitors * Reliable high-speed internet * Wired Ethernet strongly preferred * Quiet and professional workspace Candidate Assessment Before moving forward, qualified candidates will complete a practical assessment. The workbook contains: Sheet 1 — Purchase Order Sheet 2 — Vendor Bill Your assignment is to analyze the two documents and identify the differences, discrepancies, and anything else you believe management should know. Assessment workbook: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 Assessment Rules 1. Do not delete or modify the original sheets. 2. Preserve all original sheets for audit purposes. 3. Do not convert formulas to values. 4. Your workbook must remain fully auditable. 5. Show your analysis, calculations, and logic inside the Excel file. 6. Do not simply identify differences — demonstrate how you think about the business impact and what should be reviewed or followed up on. How to Apply Email your completed assessment workbook in .xlsx format to: assessments.brfoodus@gmail.com Subject: Assessment Attach the completed Excel file. We are looking for candidates who can demonstrate accuracy, analytical thinking, ownership, leadership, and strong business judgment through their work. Food Services Inc. Los Angeles, California https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H2UFgxxF1DbBJvoYJFNCnyGY_WsRKqvU/edit?gid=1320818024#gid=1320818024 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/food-service-specialties-back-office-support-1

items.description: Design Headquarters: Dire Dawa, Ethiopia URL: http://iisd.org Background The Scaling Urban Nature-based Solutions (NbS) for Climate Adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa (SUNCASA) is a 3-year project aiming at enhancing climate resilience and promoting gender equality, social inclusion, and biodiversity protection across three cities: Dire Dawa (Ethiopia), Kigali (Rwanda) and Johannesburg (South Africa). Led by the International Institute for Sustainable Development and the World Resources Institute, and implemented in partnership with local organizations and communities, SUNCASA seeks to address climate change impacts—such as floods, landslides, and soil erosion—through gender-responsive and socially inclusive NbS. These include afforestation, reforestation, agroforestry, urban greening, the removal of invasive alien species, and the creation of vegetated buffer zones in flood-prone areas. Entering its third and final year of the current implementation phase, SUNCASA is already achieving significant results, generating measurable adaptation outcomes and strengthening the resilience of communities and landscapes across its project sites. To sustain these achievements beyond the project time frame, SUNCASA is investing in building local ownership and stewardship, with a particular emphasis on engaging children and youth as future custodians of their environments. For more information, visit www.suncasa.org . As part of this effort, SUNCASA is developing a series of four animated videos, with stories and scripts co-created alongside local partners to ensure they reflect community realities, priorities, and cultural contexts. Through engaging storytelling and accessible messages, the animations will encourage young audiences to understand the importance of protecting local ecosystems and livelihoods, recognize their role in sustaining climate adaptation efforts, and contribute to building more resilient and sustainable communities. Purpose of the Consultancy Within the framework of SUNCASA’s Communications Strategy, IISD is seeking an experienced animator or animation studio to conceptualize, design, and produce a series of three animated videos showcasing the project's NbS impacts and highlighting the role of local youth in sustaining these achievements across SUNCASA's three project cities. A fourth animation will focus on promoting the project's gender equality and social inclusion (GESI) approach. Working closely with SUNCASA's Communications team and representatives from the project's local partners, the consultant will be responsible for translating existing scripts into engaging visual narratives through the development of high-quality animations of approximately 2–2.5 minutes each. The videos should communicate the project's approach, results, and impact in a way that is compelling, accessible, and suitable for diverse audiences, with a particular focus on young people. Animations and supporting illustrations must be designed on Adobe Creative Cloud software—After Effects, Illustrator, and InDesign. SUNCASA will provide relevant reference materials—including photographs, videos, project documentation, and brand assets—to inform the visual concept, character design, and storytelling. The animations will be based on scripts co-created with local partners to ensure they authentically reflect the social, cultural, and environmental contexts of each project location. The consultant will be expected to develop a distinctive visual style that resonates with local audiences while maintaining consistency across the animation series. The animations are expected to be developed primarily in English. The SUNCASA Communications team will provide all voiceover and dialogue recordings, including versions in local languages such as Amharic, Afaan Oromo, and Kinyarwanda, which the consultant will integrate into the final productions. The assignment covers the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production. Final deliverables will include landscape and portrait versions of each animation, optimized for web, social media, and mobile platforms. The consultant will also provide all editable source files—including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files—to allow future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. The completed animations will support educational and awareness-raising activities led by SUNCASA’s local partners, particularly among children and youth. They will also be disseminated through community WhatsApp and Telegram groups and promoted through SUNCASA’s and partners’ websites and social media channels, helping to expand outreach, strengthen engagement, and reinforce the long-term sustainability of project outcomes. Objectives of the Consultancy General Objective The overall objective of this consultancy is to design and produce a series of four short, animated videos that communicate the achievements and impacts of the SUNCASA project in an engaging and accessible way. This includes three animations highlighting the project’s NbS interventions and their contribution to community and ecosystem resilience across three cities, while one will focus on SUNCASA’s GESI approach. The animations aim to strengthen local ownership and long-term sustainability of project results by engaging children and youth as key audiences. Through culturally relevant storytelling co-developed with local partners, the animations should inspire behavioural change and reinforce the role of youth as key agents of resilience and environmental stewardship. The final products will serve as adaptable communication tools for community outreach, education, and broader dissemination through digital platforms and partner networks. Specific Objectives To design and produce four high-quality animated videos (approximately 2–2.5 minutes each) that communicate SUNCASA’s results, impacts, and approaches in an engaging, accessible, and visually compelling format, particularly to younger audiences. To develop three animations showcasing SUNCASA’s NbS interventions and their contribution to strengthening the resilience of communities and ecosystems across the project’s three cities. To produce one animation highlighting SUNCASA’s GESI approach and its role in promoting inclusive and equitable climate adaptation outcomes. To lead the full animation production process, including visual concept development, character and environment design, storyboarding, illustration, animation, editing, and post-production, in close collaboration with SUNCASA’s Communications team and local partners. To deliver final outputs in both landscape and portrait formats, as well as short versions of each video optimized for social media, along with all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) to enable future adaptation and reuse by the SUNCASA Communications team. Tasks and Deliverables The consultant will be responsible for leading the full animation production process as outlined below: Activity 1: Inception and Creative Development Review all aesthetics and visual reference materials provided by SUNCASA. Participate in a kickoff meeting with the SUNCASA Communications teams and representatives of the local partner organizations. Develop a creative concept and visual approach aligned with SUNCASA branding and the visual references provided. Prepare a detailed production plan and timeline, including at least three rounds of feedback and the platform on which concepts and drafts will be shared for review. Deliverable 1 : Detailed work plan, including time frame; Creative concept with animation style and visual approach. Activity 2: Storyboards - Based on the co-created scripts provided by the SUNCASA Communications team and informed by the approved creative concept, the consultant will design individual storyboards for each animation. Deliverable 2 : Individual storyboards for each video, with a detailed description of each sequence and scene. Activity 3 : Initial Video Drafts - Following the scripts provided by the SUNCASA Comms team and the approved storyboard, the consultant will develop initial versions of all four animations with no audio and submit them for review. Based on feedback, the updated versions will be created and submitted for approval. - Drafts should include motion graphics, character animations, as well as maps and geographic visualization where applicable. Deliverable 3 : The initial and updated cut of each video animation draft with no audio, including the feedback provided by the team. Activity 4: Final versions of all four animated videos in English and integration of voiceover, dialogues in local languages, as well as soundtrack; create cut-down social media cuts - The consultant will use the approved versions to integrate the voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack into each animation. - In addition to English, one animation will have a version in Kinyarwanda; and one will have versions in Amharic and Afaan Oromo—translations to be provided by the SUNCASA Communications team. - An additional round of feedback will be required at this stage before approval of the final versions. - In addition to the full animations, the consultant will deliver a cut-down version (30 to 45 seconds) of each video, optimized for social media. Deliverable 4 : A final version of each animation in English with voiceover, dialogues, and soundtrack in local languages, as applicable. A cut-down version of each animation for social media. Activity 5: Submit all editable source files (including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files) - Organize, name, and share all working files, including artwork, illustrations, animation assets, and project files. Deliverable 5 : A folder with all required assets to be shared with the SUNCASA Communications team. Read the full Terms of Reference here for Reporting, Evaluation and Selection Criteria. Consultancy for the Design and Production of Four Animated Videos Showcasing SUNCASA’s Achievements and Inspiring Youth Engagement in Sustaining Project Results Application deadline: August 3, 2026 Application Process All applications must be submitted in English. To apply for this consultancy, please send: Cover Letter outlining relevant professional experience of proposed consultant(s). Please include the name and contact details of the primary contact person. Detailed resume of proposed consultant(s) highlighting relevant experience in all stages of animation production, from creative concept to post-production. Technical Proposal outlining understanding of the assignment and how the consultant(s) plan to undertake the project, including a proposed work plan and timeline. The proposed work plan must align with the deliverables and timeline set out in Sections 4 and 5. Portfolio with at least three examples of relevant animation videos. Please indicate the links to the videos in the technical proposal. Financial Proposal that includes the consultant’s daily rate and any additional costs associated with this assignment, with all costs clearly broken down and aligned to each deliverable and key activities outlined in the Scope of Work. Financial proposals must be aligned with the scope described in Section 5 of this RFP. At least two (2) references from previous related projects.
