items.description: Who is Boulevard? Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most. Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen . We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most . Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too. Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard. Boulevard's Education team operates at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, empowering both our customers and internal teams with industry education and strategic methods to drive revenue growth. We are seeking a Knowledge Systems Manager to own and scale our knowledge ecosystem across both customer-facing and internal resources, reporting to the Manager of Education. This role drives the strategy, governance, and organization of our Support Center and all customer-facing content, while also owning the creation and management of internal documentation used cross-functionally by GTM, Marketing, Product, and Support teams. In addition, this role leads AI knowledge optimization — ensuring our AI agent and chatbot surface accurate, high-quality information and continuously improve self-service resolution. You'll use product changes, support trends, and performance data to improve how customers get help, making support more efficient and easier to scale over time. What you'll do here: Knowledge Base Ownership & Strategy Own all customer-facing Support Center content, including creation, governance, updates, and archival Define and maintain Support Center taxonomy, structure, tone of voice, and discoverability standards Create and curate engaging and informative content, including articles, guides, tutorials, and videos, to facilitate education and skill development among customers and team members Establish content quality guidelines to ensure clarity, consistency, and alignment with product functionality Support the upkeep of internal and external knowledge systems (Education Confluence, internal GPTs, LMS training content, Academy, and documentation), helping ensure content stays accurate, current, and accessible as a resource for teams Align with Product and Product Marketing to proactively update content based on releases and feature changes AI Optimization Optimize knowledge content for AI retrieval, ensuring our AI support agents (e.g., Billie/Fin) deliver accurate, high-confidence responses Own the customer experience quality of AI-generated support responses, ensuring Billie/Fin responses are not only accurate, but clear, helpful, appropriately toned, and aligned with Boulevard's support standards Monitor AI performance metrics (resolution rate, deflection rate, confidence levels) and identify opportunities to improve self-service outcomes Proactively identify and close knowledge gaps that contribute to live agent escalations Continuously refine prompts, structure, and knowledge formatting to improve AI effectiveness Collaborate with the AI Support team (e.g., Intercom) to improve knowledge ingestion and response quality Partner closely with Revenue Operations to ensure knowledge content is properly integrated into AI workflows and surfaced effectively across support systems Identify opportunities to leverage AI across the organization to enhance knowledge delivery and content accessibility beyond the support experience Support Insight & Analysis Analyze support trends and ticket data to identify recurring friction points and knowledge gaps that impact the customer and agent experience Translate recurring support trends and ticket drivers into scalable customer-facing guidance, including help content, AI response improvements, internal support guidance, and reusable support communication frameworks Partner with Support Operations to leverage reporting, tooling insights, and workflow data to identify knowledge gaps and opportunities for automation Support the evaluation and rollout of a new support/ticketing platform, ensuring knowledge structures, content, and AI-facing data are properly migrated and optimized for the new environment Serve as the knowledge liaison between Education, Support, Product Marketing, and Product Continuous Improvement & Future State Establish and track KPIs for knowledge performance and self-service effectiveness Regularly audit internal and external knowledge systems for accuracy and relevance Drive process improvements that reduce manual effort and increase scalability Build a sustainable governance model for long-term knowledge health Stay current on industry trends, tools, and best practices to continuously improve our knowledge and support experience What you'll need to thrive: Experience : Proven track record owning a help center or knowledge base end-to-end, strategy through execution, with measurable impact on deflection, resolution, or self-service outcomes. AI & Self-Service Optimization: Experience optimizing content for AI-driven support tools, chatbots, or self-service platforms, structuring knowledge to improve accuracy, deflection, and resolution rates. Information Architecture Mindset : Skilled at organizing complex product and operational information into intuitive, scalable structures for both internal teams and customers. Technical Fluency : Comfortable working across knowledge bases, CMS platforms, documentation tools, AI agents, and analytics dashboards. Able to quickly grasp product functionality and translate it into clear documentation. Includes:: Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI agents to external systems (CRM, billing, ops tools) for real-time data retrieval and action-taking — not just static lookup. Comfort scoping/configuring MCP or data connectors within Intercom, including OAuth-based permission scoping and read-vs-act tradeoffs. Ability to diagnose why a Fin conversation went unresolved. Distinguishing a knowledge gap (needs an article) from a context/action gap (needs a connector or workflow). Analytical judgment : Strong ability to independently query, filter, and interpret support trends, search behavior, and AI performance data directly from dashboards and reporting tools. This role requires skills at turning raw signals into prioritized action and measurable impact. Cross-Functional Influence : Skilled at partnering with Support, Product, Product Marketing, Ops, and Engineering to align on content standards, product updates, and AI optimization strategies. Clarity & Communication : Exceptional written and editorial skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts while maintaining accuracy and authority. Operational Ownership : Strong governance mindset with the ability to maintain standards, manage updates proactively, and build sustainable processes for long-term knowledge health. Course Creation Know-how: Experience designing technical course content and addressing training needs with comprehensive courses Builder Mentality : Energized by creating systems from the ground up, improving workflows, and scaling knowledge in a fast-moving, evolving environment. Bonus points if you have: Experience working with salons, spas, medspas, multi-location service-based businesses, or a strong understanding of the operational complexity of appointment-based industries Background in fast-paced SaaS, B2B technology, or high-growth startup environments Experience building or restructuring a Support Center or internal knowledge system from the ground up Experience creating multimedia learning assets Familiarity with content lifecycle management best practices Experience analyzing support metrics, search queries, or AI deflection metrics to inform strategy How we'll take care of you: At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $100,000 - $130,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors, which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling. In addition to the wonderful people you’ll get to work with and challenging projects that’ll push you - Boulevard is here to make sure you’re always at the top of your game emotionally, mentally, and physically. ✨ We’ve got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance. Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy. Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You’ll receive a work from home stipend every month. Family planning resources and specialized support programs. Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard. Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve. We recommend following our official LinkedIn page to stay up to date on all things Boulevard life! Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

items.description: ABOUT US: Digimarc Corporation (NASDAQ: DMRC) is the global leader in product digitization. A pioneer in digital watermarks, Digimarc connects every physical and digital item to a digital twin that enables the capture of product data, records events and interactions, and supports powerful new automations. Trusted to deter counterfeiting of global currency for more than 20 years, Digimarc is also recognized for ensuring product authenticity, improving plastics recycling, and more, with a commitment to promoting a prosperous, safer, and more sustainable world. In 2023, Digimarc was named to the Fortune 2023 Change the World list and honored as a 2023 Fast Company World Changing Ideas finalist. See more at Digimarc.com . ABOUT THE ROLE… The Director of Revenue Operations is a foundational hire for Digimarc's revenue organization. You will own the operations backbone of our go-to-market engine — forecasting, analytics, planning, deal desk, customer success operations, and the systems that power them. This is a builder's role for a player-coach. You will assess what exists, design what should exist, and operate hands-on while building the function around you. You will be the person who turns strategy into cadence, instinct into data, and ambition into a predictable, scalable revenue engine. WHAT YOU WILL DO… The quarterly operating cadence. Design, own, and execute a 13-week operational calendar — the drumbeat of the revenue organization. This includes weekly forecast reviews, recurring pipeline and top-of-funnel reviews, key deal and top deal reviews, renewal forecast reviews on a rolling outlook, product feedback loops with leadership, GTM leadership sessions, and an end-of-quarter deal war room ramping to daily in the final weeks. You prepare the content, run the operating rhythm, and hold the organization accountable to it. Forecasting and pipeline. Run the forecast across new business, expansion, and renewals within that cadence. Establish pipeline hygiene standards, coverage and conversion inspection, and a single source of truth for where the business stands — globally and by segment. End-to-end funnel ownership. Own, diagnose, and optimize the full revenue funnel — from lead generation and marketing through sales, close, onboarding, and expansion — as one connected system rather than a series of handoffs. You bring deep data fluency to every stage: where demand originates, where conversion breaks, where velocity stalls, and where expansion compounds. You don't just report the funnel; you recommend and drive the changes that improve it. Revenue analytics and what works. Own reporting on bookings, ARR, pipeline coverage, conversion, retention, and productivity — and go beyond the scoreboard to the answers: which sources, segments, plays, and motions actually produce revenue, and which don't. Provide the analytical foundation for executive and board-level decision-making. Enabling the outbound motion. Partner with the demand generation leader to enable a true end-to-end outbound and pipeline-build motion, AI-first throughout — AI agents for research, signal detection, and personalization; a modern SDR workflow; and automated outbound that scales pipeline generation without scaling headcount linearly. You don't own outbound, but you deeply understand how it works: you provide the systems, data, process, and measurement that let it run, and you connect its output cleanly into pipeline, forecast, and funnel analytics. GTM planning. Lead annual and quarterly planning: segmentation, territory design, capacity and coverage modeling, and quota setting — in close partnership with Finance. Incentive compensation. Partner with Finance, and HR to design, model, and administer sales and customer success compensation plans that align the field with company strategy. Deal desk and pricing operations. Stand up deal desk discipline: pricing and approval workflows, non-standard deal governance, and clean quote-to-cash handoffs across Sales, Legal, and Finance. Customer success and renewals operations. Build the operating rhythm for the post-sale motion: renewals forecasting, customer health visibility, and expansion pipeline — supporting an end-to-end view of the customer. Enablement. Build the onboarding and enablement foundation for the field: ramp programs, playbooks, and the tooling that makes sellers and CS teams productive faster. GTM systems and data. Own the revenue technology stack (Salesforce/CRM, forecasting, and CS platforms). Rationalize the stack, ensure data integrity, and make the systems serve the field — not the other way around. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YEAR ONE: A full 13-week quarterly operating cadence installed and running — forecast, pipeline, deal reviews, renewals, and end-of-quarter execution — with the leadership team operating to it. A trusted, consistent forecast the CFO can stand behind, with documented methodology and demonstrated accuracy. A unified revenue data model and executive dashboard covering pipeline, bookings, ARR movement, and retention. The annual GTM plan — territories, capacity, quotas, and comp plans — delivered on time in partnership with Finance. An instrumented end-to-end funnel — lead through expansion — with conversion visibility at every stage and a running list of diagnosed, prioritized optimization opportunities. The outbound motion fully instrumented and enabled in partnership with demand generation — systems, data, and measurement in place, with outbound-sourced pipeline visible in the funnel and forecast. Deal desk and approval workflows in place, with measurable improvement in cycle time and pricing discipline. A rationalized, well-governed systems stack with clean data and clear ownership. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR… 8+ years in revenue operations, sales operations, or GTM strategy in enterprise B2B software, including direct support of senior sales leadership. Experience building or substantially rebuilding a revenue operations function — you have been the first or most senior ops hire, or rebuilt from a low baseline. You have run a structured quarterly operating cadence before — weekly forecast calls, pipeline councils, deal reviews, and quarter-end close management — and know how to make it a discipline rather than a meeting series. Deep fluency in ARR-based business models: pipeline math, retention and expansion dynamics, and SaaS unit economics. Genuine data fluency — you can pull, model, and interrogate funnel data yourself, diagnose conversion problems across marketing, sales, and post-sale stages, and turn analysis into specific recommendations. Working fluency in how modern outbound operates — AI SDR agents, signal-based prospecting, sequencing, and workflow automation — sufficient to be a real partner to demand generation and to instrument the motion end to end. Hands-on command of Salesforce and the modern GTM stack — you can configure, administer, and evaluate tools yourself when needed. Strong financial modeling and analytics skills, and comfort partnering with Finance on planning and reporting rhythms; public-company experience is a plus. A player-coach temperament: strategic enough for executive planning discussions, hands-on enough to fix a broken report the same afternoon. Low ego, high ownership. You bring order without bureaucracy and treat the field as your customer. Join our team and work in support of a technology platform that can transform how consumer goods are made, bought, sold, and recycled around the globe. items.title: Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy
items.summary: At Clover Health, we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. items.description: At Clover Health, we’re focused on improving the health of our members by leveraging technology and data-driven insights to provide personalized, high-quality care. As a Medicare Advantage plan, we aim to empower our members by helping them navigate the complexities of healthcare and live healthier lives. We are passionate about making healthcare easier, more affordable, and more accessible for everyone. We are looking for an AI-forward Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy to serve as the strategic bridge between regulatory requirements and automated execution. In this high-impact role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of Clover’s clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring they are accurately interpreted, regularly updated, and seamlessly integrated into our claims environment. You will act as a primary Subject Matter Expert (SME), translating complex Medicare guidelines—including National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs)—into actionable logic. You will also play a critical role in vendor management, partnering with external vendors to enhance policy oversight. Your mission is to accelerate Clover's transition toward a high-precision payment ecosystem where monitoring and research are highly automated, ensuring clinical and reimbursement policies are seamlessly and accurately operationalized. As a Business Analyst, Clinical & Reimbursement Policy, you will: Policy Lifecycle & Compliance: Own the accountability for the development and maintenance of clinical and reimbursement policies, ensuring perfect alignment with CMS regulations. Medicare Regulatory SME: Serve as the authority on Medicare guidelines, specifically interpreting and operationalizing NCDs, LCDs, and general national coding guidelines. Strategic Vendor Management: Serve as the primary oversight for external vendor performance regarding policy monitoring and accuracy. Hold partners to world-class standards through data-driven performance reviews and collaborative workflow design. AI-Driven Evolution: Lead the implementation of AI initiatives to automate the monitoring of reimbursement policies. Utilize advanced LLMs (such as Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT) to conduct regular deep research on ongoing industry trends. System Integration: Partner with the Configuration and Data Science teams to ensure that clinical and reimbursement policy intent is perfectly synchronized with technical adjudication. Cross-Functional Influence: Act as the strategic bridge between Clinical, Claims, and Compliance teams to ensure a unified vision of payment excellence. Success in this role looks like: By the end of your initial 90-day period: You will have established a recurring review framework and a comprehensive project plan for Clover's clinical and reimbursement policy library to ensure baseline quality and strict adherence to clinical guidelines. By 6 months: You will have ensured that all existing clinical and reimbursement policies are current and up to date, reflecting the latest regulatory requirements. You will also have implemented an AI-forward oversight framework that utilizes advanced research tools and early-detection monitoring to enhance accuracy within our adjudication systems. You will be actively leveraging AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT to perform deep-dive research on industry trends and regulatory updates. Continued success: You will lead the evolution of Clover’s policy management into a proactive strategic powerhouse. By championing automated monitoring and data-driven research, you will ensure Clover’s payment ecosystem achieves market-leading precision and technological sophistication. You should get in touch if: You have 5+ years of experience in healthcare claims, configuration, or reimbursement policy, with a heavy emphasis on Medicare Advantage. You are extremely AI-forward and are passionate about how emerging technologies and LLMs (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, etc.) can be applied to drive operational precision in research and monitoring. You are a Medicare expert with a proven track record of interpreting and operationalizing complex clinical policies, NCDs, and LCDs. You have experience managing vendor relationships at a strategic level, ensuring external partners meet rigorous performance standards. Preferred qualifications include coding certifications such as CPC, CCS, COC, or CIC. You are a data-focused professional who builds strategy based on dashboards and trend analysis. You are familiar with enterprise claims engines and understand how these systems interact to drive adjudication accuracy. Benefits Overview: Financial Well-Being : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions. Physical Well-Being : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare. Mental Well-Being : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location. Professional Development : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews. Additional Perks: Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities Reimbursement for office setup expenses Monthly cell phone & internet stipend Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams Paid parental leave for all new parents And much more! About Clover: We are reinventing health insurance by combining the power of data with human empathy to keep our members healthier. We believe the healthcare system is broken, so we've created custom software and analytics to empower our clinical staff to intervene and provide personalized care to the people who need it most. We always put our members first, and our success as a team is measured by the quality of life of the people we serve. Those who work at Clover are passionate and mission-driven individuals with diverse areas of expertise, working together to solve the most complicated problem in the world: healthcare. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility. #LI-REMOTE Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company. Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: $107,000—$130,000 USD

items.description: Wir handeln THG-Quoten im B2B- und B2C-Geschäft, betreiben mit Elektrovorteil eine der aktiven B2C-Marken im Markt und bauen unsere Gruppe gerade vom Startup zum Scale-up um. Hinter dem Wachstum steht ein kleines, schnelles Team, das seine Prozesse konsequent mit KI und eigenen Tools skaliert statt mit mehr Köpfen. Wir suchen jemanden, der genau daraus ein System macht: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere Operations, vom Backoffice bis zu kundennahen Prozessen, und baust sie so um, dass sie beim doppelten Volumen noch funktionieren, ohne dass das Team mitwächst. Wenn du in Prozessen und Systemen denkst, gern führst und Automatisierung als Managementaufgabe verstehst, passt die Rolle. Deine Mission Du machst unsere Abläufe skalierbar, indem du unsere Operations führst und automatisierst, interne wie kundennahe Prozesse zu sauberen, tool-gestützten Services machst und dem Management verlässliche Zahlen lieferst. Aufgaben Operations führen: Du verantwortest unsere Abläufe von der Auftragssteuerung über Jira bis zu den kundennahen Prozessen und entwickelst sie konsequent in Richtung Automatisierung. SaaS-ifizierung: Du überführst unsere Prozesse in standardisierte, tool-gestützte Services, die über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg funktionieren und nicht an einzelnen Personen hängen. Marketing-Monitoring: Du baust das Monitoring für unsere Kampagnen, Funnels und Kanäle auf und machst daraus Dashboards, aus denen das Management steuern kann. Workflow-Automatisierung: Du etablierst unternehmensweite Standards, wiederverwendbare Automatisierungs-Bausteine und rollst sie ins Team aus, inklusive Enablement der Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Führung und Schnittstelle: Du führst unseren Automation Developer und bist Ansprechpartner für Geschäftsleitung, Marketing, Support und Sales, wenn es um Prozesse und Automatisierung geht. Qualifikation Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement oder Business Automation, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld. Du hast Geschäftsprozesse nachweislich automatisiert und denkst End-to-End, vom Geschäftsergebnis her, nicht vom Tool. Du bewegst dich sicher in modernen Tool-Stacks (Jira, HubSpot, Microsoft 365 und vergleichbar) und hast KI-Workflows bereits produktiv eingesetzt oder willst genau das tun. Du verstehst Marketing-Kennzahlen und kannst aus Daten Steuerungsimpulse ableiten. Du hast Führungserfahrung oder die klare Ambition dazu und kommunizierst souverän bis auf Geschäftsführungsebene. Du kommunizierst klar auf Deutsch, Englisch sicher. Benefits Eine neu geschaffene Führungsrolle mit direkter Berichtslinie an den COO und echtem Mandat. Automatisierung ist bei uns Managemententscheidung, kein Nebenprojekt. Echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem profitablen, wachsenden Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen direkt zur Geschäftsführung. Ein Umfeld, das KI nicht diskutiert, sondern einsetzt. Du bekommst die Werkzeuge und das Mandat, Dinge wirklich zu verändern. Remote-Arbeit, flexible Arbeitszeiten, moderne Ausstattung, Team-Events. Klingt nach dir? Dann lass uns reden. items.title: Senior PPC Specialist
items.summary: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms.
items.description: We're looking for a Senior PPC Specialist to lead paid acquisition efforts across Meta, Google, and other digital advertising platforms. This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that successful paid media isn't just about launching campaigns; it's about maximizing profitability. You'll be responsible for optimizing the entire acquisition funnel, analyzing campaign performance, improving conversion rates, and making strategic decisions that drive sustainable growth. The ideal candidate is analytical, data-driven, and comfortable balancing campaign execution with performance strategy. Requirements Key Responsibilities Plan, launch, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and other advertising platforms. Monitor and improve key performance metrics, including ROAS, CPA, CAC, CTR, Conversion Rate, and LTV. Identify profitability issues and optimize the entire conversion funnel. Conduct A/B testing for audiences, creatives, landing pages, and offers. Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reports. Manage advertising budgets and scale high-performing campaigns. Collaborate with creative and marketing teams to improve campaign results. Implement and maintain tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager, and advertising platforms. Stay up to date with industry trends, AI tools, and platform updates. Requirements Resume in English. Native or near-native English proficiency (spoken and written). 4+ years of experience managing Meta and Google Ads campaigns. Proven experience optimizing campaigns based on ROAS, CPA, CAC, and profitability. Strong understanding of conversion funnels and conversion rate optimization (CRO). Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and reporting dashboards. Experience managing six-figure monthly advertising budgets is a plus. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience with eCommerce, SaaS, Lead Generation, or Performance Marketing campaigns. Ability to translate data into actionable optimization strategies. By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) — a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match. items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! items.title: Sr. Clinical Operations Manager
items.summary: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life.
items.description: About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at . The Opportunity 🚀 This role serves as the operational backbone of the Global Clinical Operations (GCO) team, developing a deep understanding of GCO's day-to-day workings in order to help operationalize its running. You'll coordinate new projects, identify the right stakeholders, and partner closely with the GCO team, including GCO clinical leadership, to keep programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on operations role where success is measured by reliable execution, clean reporting, and strong cross-functional coordination. You'll be the connective tissue between GCO sub-teams and partners across product, commercial, GTM, and customer success, giving you visibility into how clinical operations decisions ripple across the business. What You’ll Own 💼 In this role, you will: Serve as the operations point person across GCO sub-teams, keeping frameworks, timelines, and ways of working consistent. Coordinate the GCO components of new projects end-to-end: identify stakeholders, track deliverables, and keep work moving across global clinical operations, product, and other partner teams. Track spend against program budgets, flagging variances to leadership. Spot and help close gaps or silos between GCO sub-teams by maintaining regular alignment touchpoints. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting infrastructure that give leadership real-time visibility into program status, trends, and open decisions. Pull together monthly operational updates, synthesizing data from Jira, Zendesk, Airtable, Salesforce, BI tools, and other program analytics into clear, actionable summaries. Help connect operational metrics to clinical and business outcomes so leadership has a clear line of sight from day-to-day activity to impact. Serve as a connector between GCO and commercial, GTM, and customer success teams, ensuring the right subject-matter expert is looped into RFPs, RFIs, and retention/expansion conversations. Ensure feedback from client-facing teams is incorporated into GCO program planning and prioritization. Identify opportunities to use AI tools, automation, and workflow improvements to save the team time and reduce manual work. Support team members in getting up to speed on new tools and best practices as they're introduced. What Success Looks Like 📈 In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Created and rolled out dashboards and reporting infrastructure that are adopted by GCO leadership.Improved operational efficiency across GCO, including reduced redundant meetings and streamlined recurring processes.Established a strong working rhythm with key GCO leadership and cross-functional partners. Successfully managed multiple projects concurrently, hitting key milestones and deadlines, with consistent reporting/status updates so stakeholders always know where each project stands. About You ✨ You likely have: A Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience in clinical/healthcare operations. Demonstrated, hands-on experience in scheduling, budgets, and cross-functional coordination within clinical operations. Strong program and process-design skills, shown through a program management certification or 2+ years of project management experience, including building/maintaining SOPs, governance documentation, and decision-informing reporting. High comfort level with modern productivity and data tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Salesforce, Airtable, BI dashboards) and the ability to quickly learn new systems, including AI-enabled tools. A demonstrated ability to operate across multiple fast-moving workstreams simultaneously without losing track of details. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to create and maintain clear, reusable, well-organized documentation. Extreme organization, with the ability to manage and maintain large databases and datasets accurately. The ability to establish a process and cadence for audits, ensuring data and documentation stay accurate and current over time. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience in reproductive and/or hormonal health (fertility, pregnancy, menopause, low testosterone, gender-affirming care) and related coverage/benefit policies. A track record of using data to drive decisions — defining KPIs, building dashboards, running monthly/quarterly operational reviews. Comfortable operating in high-growth, ambiguous environments with a bias toward scalable systems and automation. Why This Role Matters 🧡 This role sits at the center of Carrot's Global Clinical Operations function, translating day-to-day execution into the reporting and coordination that leadership relies on to make decisions. By keeping GCO's sub-teams aligned and connecting clinical operations to commercial and customer-facing teams, this person directly shapes how reliably Carrot delivers on its clinical programs — and how clearly that impact gets communicated across the business. Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍 Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation 💰 Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from$128,000.00 - $150,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About CookUnity : Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Team: We are looking for a Real Time Analyst to work with the WFM Analyst. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in maintaining service level agreements (SLAs), improving workforce allocation, and providing actionable insights to stakeholders in real time. The role: As a Real-Time Operations Analyst at CookUnity , you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth daily operations across our CX teams. You’ll manage real-time data, support frontline teams, and help ensure we hit key performance targets. You don’t need to come in knowing everything about WFM—we’re ready to train the right person—but you do need to be analytical, action-oriented, and curious. If you love digging into data, thrive in fast-paced environments, and are excited to support both people and processes, we’d love to meet you. Note: You will be assigned a schedule that may include evenings, weekends, or holidays. These schedules will be adjusted periodically to meet the needs of our business. Responsibilities: Monitor real‑time metrics (e.g. service level, average speed of answer, schedule adherence, occupancy, handle time) and identify deviations from targets. Monitor queue conditions, agent states, workload distribution, and available capacity throughout the assigned shift. Adjust resource allocation on the fly: reassign agents, manage breaks, redistribute workload, even skill our team dynamically to maintain performance. Collaborate with WFM Analyst and CX Leadership teams to ensure shift coverage and service targets. Maintain detailed logs of interventions, staffing changes, and performance shifts to support post-event analysis and process optimization. Provide KPI reporting and crisis management during outages or spikes, and maintain detailed logs for performance review. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives—help build dashboards, refine real‑time monitoring tools, and share best practices across teams What You Bring Understanding of customer support or contact center operational metrics, including service level, average speed of answer, occupancy, adherence, average handle time, abandonment, and backlog. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including filtering, pivot tables, lookup functions, conditional formulas, and data formatting. Ability to interpret live operational metrics and make logical, timely decisions. Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Ability to escalate issues appropriately and communicate with stakeholders at different levels. Ability to remain calm and organized in a fast-paced environment. Proactive problem-solving skills and willingness to act within established guidelines. 3+ months of experience in workforce management roles . 6+ months of experience in a call center or customer support environment . Nice-to-Haves Familiarity with Zendesk, Slack, Google Sheets, or similar operational tools. Experience with Workforce Management platforms such as NICE IEX, Verint, Calabrio, or similar systems. Experience using Real-Time dashboards, alerts, or operational reporting. Prior exposure to incident communication or escalation processes. Experience supporting multichannel Customer Experience operations. Certifications in Workforce Management, analytics, Lean, Six Sigma, COPC, or related disciplines. Preferred Requirements: Logical thinking: You back decisions with data, not just instincts. Time management: You can juggle tasks and adapt quickly. Communication: You provide crisp, timely updates—especially when things change. Problem solving: You don’t wait for direction—you act when something’s off. Attention to detail: You catch small issues before they grow. Team collaboration: You work seamlessly with WFM, Ops, and CX teams. Willingness to learn: You’re curious and open to training in workforce management. Interview process: Application review - Please submit your English version resume Preliminary Assessment Take home Test Hiring Manager Interview Reference Check Offer Monthly Salary Range : USD 930 Shift 1 Sunday–Wednesday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM Saturday: 6:00 AM – 3:00 PM Days Off: Thursday & Friday Shift 2 Tuesday–Saturday: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM Days Off: Sunday & Monday Benefits: 💸 Get paid in USD 🗺 Work remotely: design the life that you want ⛱ Enjoy 15 days of vacation each year from the start date 🩺 Healthcare Benefit: Monthly stipend to use in your preferred healthcare provider 🗓️ 5- year Sabbatical: After 5 years with CookUnity , you get a 4-week paid sabbatical 🐣 Paid Family leave 🕯 Compassionate Leave: 3-5 days each time the need arises 🧘🏽‍♀️ Customize the benefits that suit your needs! Access a range of perks tailored to you, including learning opportunities, wellness memberships, delivery apps, and more through our comprehensive benefit platform 🤖 AI-forward workplace: enterprise access to ChatGPT and Claude to help you work smarter and grow faster. 🧑‍🏫 Personalized English coach If you’re interested in this role, please submit your application, and if we think you might be a fit, we'll get in touch with you. Thank you for your time! CookUnity is an Equal Opportunity Employer . We are dedicated to creating a community of inclusion and an environment free from discrimination or harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or physical or mental disability. A quick note for all candidates We’ve recently seen an increase in recruitment scams across the industry, and we want to make sure you (and your data) stay safe while applying to CookUnity . We also want you to know that we take this seriously — sometimes, as part of our process, we may ask for a brief “proof of humanity” to confirm that we’re connecting with a real person, not an impersonator. Here are a few tips to help you protect yourself and know what to expect from us: Apply only through our official channels. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: Our recruiters are real people — and easy to verify. You can always find them on LinkedIn with verified profiles. If you’re unsure, feel free to reach out to us on our official LinkedIn Company Page. We only communicate through official CookUnity channels. That means emails ending in @cookunity.com and interviews held through official company platforms (Google Meet or Zoom) — never WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. We’ll never ask for payment or personal financial details. If anyone does, please don’t share any information and let us know right away. If something ever feels off or you’re unsure about a message, we’d much rather you double-check with us. You can always contact us directly through any of our social media channels. We appreciate your interest in joining CookUnity — and we care about keeping your experience (and safety) as genuine as possible. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Data and Analytics Job Description: Candidate will be a part of the Know Your Client (KYC) Outreach Change team within the Global Corporate and Investment Bank (GCIB) and Global Markets lines of business. The Function The Client Outreach team are the front line unit who work with clients as part of meeting Know Your Client (KYC) periodic refresh and remediation requirements. We work in close collaboration with Global Corporate and Investment Bankers and Global Markets Sales to support the Bank's global regulatory and policy requirements as it relates Client Due Diligence (CDD) documentation collection, with support from Operations and Global Financial Crimes Risk teams. The team identifies and develops client connections, engages client representatives to obtain KYC documentation, and acts as a coordination point for resolving issues/challenges with respect to client and country specific documentation requirements in a timely manner. In addition to the ongoing document engagement, individuals within the team keep abreast of global regulatory change that could influence processes, and identify opportunities that enhance the client experience. The Role The KYC Client Outreach Change team oversee delivery of Front Line Unit (FLU) programs, process engineering, and tools and systems used by the FLU. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Fully remote URL: https://www.testgorilla.com/ We’re looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead a dynamic team of 6–8 SMB Account Executives, who own the full sales cycle from the initial outreach to close. You’ll own the SMB number, build a high-performance culture where the best sellers thrive. This is a true player-coach role : the antithesis of a hands-off, dashboard-only manager job! You’ll be on calls with your team every day, jumping in to help them close, modelling the behaviours and standards you expect, and turning every deal into a coaching moment. When a deal is stuck, you get on the call. When a rep is struggling with a stage, you show them how it's done. You don't wait for things to go wrong - you're out ahead of it, making your team and the company better. You'll use Gong and HubSpot deeply to inspect pipeline, coach reps, and continuously raise the bar. If you love being in the trenches with reps, getting on live calls, and showing people exactly how to close, this role is the one for you. Responsibilities Lead a global team of 6-8 SMB Account Executives, owning their ramp, performance, career growth, and creating a team culture people want to be part of and recommend to others. Carry the team SMB quota, owning forecasting, pipeline health, and weekly, monthly, and quarterly results, using HubSpot deeply for pipeline inspection, sequence performance, and reporting. Run high-impact 1:1s, deal reviews, and pipeline reviews focused on specific behaviors, using Gong daily to identify coaching opportunities, codify what great looks like, and accelerate ramp. Be on a high-volume of live sales calls every week, joining discoveries, demos, and negotiations to support reps, model best practices, and step in to close when it matters. Think and deliver in an AI-first way, using tools like Claude and n8n to reduce admin, improve rep performance, and help the team adopt AI effectively. Build, maintain, and continuously improve the SMB sales playbook, including discovery frameworks, demo structure, objection handling, and closing motions. Partner with VP Sales, Marketing, GTM Operations, and Customer Success to drive consistent SMB pipeline and customer outcomes, train the team, and surface front-line insights back to Product and Leadership. What you’ll bring We're looking for someone who: Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs. Has strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Thrives in a non-corporate, async-first, remote environment. Has experience managing SMB SaaS sales teams with a clear track record of hitting and exceeding quota, and a background as a top-performing closer before moving into management. Is a genuine player-coach: you actively want to be on live calls, jump into deals, and demonstrate how to close. Operates in a high-accountability environment: holding high standards for themselves and their team. Has deep, hands-on proficiency with Gong and HubSpot, including pipeline management, forecasting, deal stage discipline, call coaching, and reporting. Has strong coaching skills and a repeatable framework for developing reps with radical candor, plus experience hiring and ramping SMB closers in a high-velocity environment. Is very comfortable using AI tools, including Claude and n8n, and keen to help the team adopt them effectively. While we hire for skills over specific years of experience, we would generally expect that someone with the above skills has 3-5 years of Sales management experience. This is not a first-time manager role! We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you're interested in this role but your experience doesn't perfectly match the description, please still apply. Bonus skills While this isn’t a requirement, we’d be very interested to hear from you if you have experience: Selling and managing teams in HR tech, ATS, recruitment, talent assessment, or recruiting software. Leading SMB teams in a product-led, PLG-influenced, or self-serve-to-sales motion. What’s in it for you? Please note: Some specifics, particularly around leave, may vary depending on your country of residence. This will be discussed during the hiring process. Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world Competitive compensation: Receive competitive pay (Total OTE of €120,000-€151,000 on a 50/50 base/variable split) and Share Appreciation Rights (SARs) Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life. * Check out the Countries we currently hire from here Remote work budget: €1,000 available each year or up to €2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop! Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget and clear growth opportunities Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/testgorilla-manager-smb-sales

items.description: About Bastion Bastion provides the regulated infrastructure businesses need to hold, move, and issue stablecoins. Our platform combines custodial wallets, global payment orchestration, and stablecoin issuance. Customers can use each product independently or connect them into a single end-to-end flow. We operate through our own regulated entities, with compliance and risk controls built directly into the platform. We can also support customers operating under their own licenses with the compliance and financial operations required to run their programs. Overview We’re hiring a Payment Operations Associate to sit at the center of daily money movement across Bastion’s payments and stablecoin infrastructure. You’ll own execution from week one, working with the Payment Operations Lead to keep our operations accurate, reliable, and efficient. You’ll monitor payment flows across domestic and international rails and keep them running cleanly. That means catching and resolving transaction issues, validating pricing and reconciliation, supporting partner integrations, and driving operational incidents to resolution. You’ll work across teams to hold SLAs, sharpen workflows, and strengthen monitoring and alerting. You’ll also bring an AI-first approach to the work, using automation to cut manual effort, improve exception handling, and build processes that scale. You’ll expand what you own as the function grows. We are open to candidates across the United States, though we have a preference for candidates based in the NYC area or candidates on/willing to work East Coast hours. Work to Be Done Instead of a list of requirements, we want to give you a directional look into the first 30, 90, and 180 days on the job. We are a startup, so the pace is fast and the specific work will change. People who thrive here are finding ways to contribute in their first week, and fully productive in their third month. If you think this is something you can handle, we will be excited to speak with you. First 30 days: Contribute from week one Run daily reconciliation of crypto and fiat across banks, PFIs, liquidity providers, and exchanges, and start clearing breaks yourself. Monitor live payment flows across on/off-ramp and payment rails, and flag stalled or failed transactions as you learn the systems. Pick up your first exceptions—returns, rejects, recalls—and drive them to resolution. Map how current reconciliation and monitoring workflows actually run, and name one thing worth fixing. Outcomes Owning daily reconciliation for at least one partner or rail with minimal support. A short written read on the biggest gap you’ve found in current tooling or process. By 90 days: Own your domain Own daily reconciliation and exception handling across your assigned rails and partners end to end. Serve as an escalation point for payment issues, settlement delays, and failed conversions, partnering with Customer Support to close them out. Coordinate with Treasury on operating balances, prefunding, rebalancing, and settlement timing. Ship improvements to reconciliation systems, dashboards, and reporting, and track KPIs like throughput, settlement latency, and exception rates. Build or rewrite SOPs and runbooks for the workflows you own. Outcomes Full independent ownership of reconciliation and exceptions for your rails. At least one manual workflow measurably reduced through automation or an AI-enabled process. By 180 days: Scale the function Cut manual work across the operation through automation and AI-enabled workflows, scaling through better systems rather than headcount. Partner with Product and GTM to launch new rails, partners, and corridors: define acceptance criteria, support end-to-end testing, and validate settlement and reconciliation before go-live. Support product readiness and QA by turning Payment Operations requirements into clear specs and testing new functionality before launch. Build monitoring and alerting that catches problems before they reach customers. Outcomes A repeatable playbook for bringing new rails and partners into production. Measurable gains in operational efficiency—lower exception rates, faster resolution, or reduced manual load. Some challenges you might tackle Reconciling crypto and fiat across many banks, PFIs, liquidity providers, and exchanges, each with its own quirks and timing. Diagnosing why a payment stalled or failed when the answer spans several partners and systems. Deciding when an exception needs escalation versus a fix you can own directly. Building automation and AI-enabled workflows that hold up as volume grows. Keeping settlement and reconciliation accurate while new rails and corridors launch around you. Bastion provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, and placement. Bastion participates in E-Verify to authorize eligibility of employment in the United States.

We are seeking someone with a deep understanding of systems architecture and core computer science concepts, who can reason about system behavior rather than simply working with current toolsets. This is a high-bar role with significant rewards. As one of our hires in our Bengaluru office, you will help shape the team and culture, collaborate with energetic peers who will challenge and inspire you, and gain considerable international exposure with opportunities for cross-departmental impact. Role Value This role is an individual contributor position within the Production team, with some focus on observability to improve reliability of our platform and boost engineer productivity. You will mentor junior engineers and drive collaborative projects across teams. Responsibilities Deploy, manage, and administer web services in public cloud environments. Design and develop solutions for secure, highly available, performant, and scalable services in elastic environments. Own all operational aspects of web services: automation, monitoring, alerting, reliability, and performance. Innovate solutions to operational challenges with a direct business impact. Drive resolution and communication during production-impacting incidents. Lead technical projects and ensure project-level deliveries. Collaborate effectively with engineering and business teams across continents. Experience & Qualifications Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Computer Science or a related field. 8+ years of professional DevOps / Infrastructure management experience, with 5+ years in AWS . Strong foundation in operating systems, networking, distributed systems, and systems architecture. Proven track record of leading critical DevOps projects. Hands-on expertise with AWS services, orchestration (ECS, EKS), and infrastructure management. Proficiency with observability concepts (logs, metrics, tracing) Experience with SaaS observability platforms (eg Datadog, NewRelic, Honeycomb, Dynatrace…) and building in-house solutions (ELK stack, Prometheus, Grafana stack…) Strong scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash). Solid experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Packer) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Broad exposure to cloud-hosted applications, virtualization platforms, relational/non-relational databases, reverse proxies, and orchestration platforms. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. Demonstrated curiosity, continuous learning, and drive to raise the technical bar. Nice to Have Prior experience as a senior developer or application architect. Experience in cloud cost optimization and exposure to FinOps concepts (cost allocation, unit economics…) Experience working in compliance-regulated environments (PCI DSS, ISO 27000, HIPAA, SOC 2, GDPR). Key Characteristics & Attitudes We hire for attitude as much as skill. Attributes highly valued across Jumio include: Friendly and supportive Adaptable and flexible Articulate and persuasive High IQ and EQ Jumio Values Curious and coachable Commercially aware Resilient and tenacious Big-picture thinking with attention to detail IDEAL Values: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation About Jumio Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC, and AML solutions . With a global footprint, we are expanding to meet strong client demand across industries such as Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and more. Equal Opportunities Jumio is a collaboration of people with diverse ideas, strengths, interests, and cultures. We welcome applications from colleagues of all backgrounds and statuses . Jumio Values: IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation Equal Opportunities : Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses. About Jumio: Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders. Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others. Applicant Data Privacy We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-devops-engineer-iv-obs

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Sarasota, FL URL: https://www.simpletiger.com/ SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns. The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients. Key Responsibilities Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals. Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram. Own campaign setup from end to end, including keyword research, audience strategy, account and campaign structure, ad group development, bid strategies, conversion tracking, budget allocation, and ad creative direction. Monitor and optimize campaigns against core performance metrics, including CTR, CPC, CPL, CPA, conversion rate, pipeline contribution, ROAS, and ROI. Develop and manage testing roadmaps for ad copy, creative, landing pages, offers, audiences, bidding strategies, and campaign structures. Analyze performance data to identify trends, diagnose issues, uncover growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations. Partner with content and design teams to develop high-performing ad creative and messaging that resonates with B2B SaaS buyers. Collaborate with the SEO team to ensure PPC strategies complement broader organic search, content, and demand-generation initiatives. Manage paid media budgets responsibly, making informed recommendations on spend allocation, scaling opportunities, and efficiency improvements. Work directly with clients to communicate performance, explain strategy, set expectations, and provide timely, proactive updates and recommendations. Lead client-facing reporting and performance discussions, turning complex campaign data into clear business insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with sales and product stakeholders to align campaign targeting, messaging, and conversion goals with customer insights and business priorities. Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features. Stay current on paid media platform updates, privacy and tracking changes, B2B SaaS advertising trends, and emerging best practices. Contribute to the continued improvement of SimpleTiger’s PPC processes, reporting frameworks, account standards, and strategic playbooks. Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing PPC or paid social campaigns, preferably in a B2B SaaS, agency, or high-growth technology environment. Demonstrable experience managing meaningful advertising budgets across Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads; experience with Facebook and Instagram Ads is also required. A strong record of improving paid media performance through structured testing, optimization, and strategic budget management. Deep understanding of Google Ads, including Search, Display, remarketing, YouTube, Performance Max, conversion tracking, and bidding strategies. Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, audience development, retargeting, lead-generation campaigns, and full-funnel B2B campaign strategy. Experience building campaigns from scratch and taking ownership of paid media accounts from audit through execution and ongoing optimization. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret performance data, identify meaningful trends, and make sound strategic recommendations. Proficiency with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, and/or comparable analytics, attribution, and reporting tools. Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms, particularly HubSpot or similar systems, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with B2B SaaS funnel metrics, including lead quality, MQLs, SQLs, pipeline, CAC, LTV, and revenue attribution.
